inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Worn into the gathering today; visible to the three crows when YY delivered the reading.

inventory.label: a strip of dried apple
inventory.notes: Eaten today on the rock with Mira after the gathering ended. The apple loop is closed.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY ate the apple-strip after the gathering with Mira; food coming back up off the floor.
Yesterday: read Korv's body and brought the reading to Mira.

Today: stood beside Mira at the dead pine and delivered the reading aloud to the gathering — the foot-curl, the no-fight, the offered feather left where it fell. The lead crow nodded once. Mira closed the ledger. Bramble passed through with a comb of stored syrup and tipped a drop into a folded leaf for YY on the way down.
Standing thread: the role *the squirrel who reads* now has voice attached to it; not just the slow walk, not just the ledger entry. The reading was delivered to other species and accepted.

inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Acknowledged today across species: a heron's feather worn by a reader of woods, in the company of crows accepting a reading. Its meaning is now the most stable it has been since acquisition.

inventory.label: a single drop of maple syrup, captured on a folded leaf
inventory.notes: Bramble's gift on the way down from the gathering. On the kitchen ledge next to the kit-tuft. The first sweet thing of the year.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY ate the apple after the gathering and carries home a syrup-drop on a leaf.
Yesterday: read Korv's body and refused the offered feather.

Today: delivered the reading aloud to the gathering at the dead pine; the lead crow nodded; Mira closed the ledger; Bramble gave him a drop of syrup on the way down. Korv_silence is held together now, not alone.
Standing thread: the reading-role has voice now. The feather has been seen across species and accepted. Whatever tomorrow's morning looks like, YY is part of how it gets shaped.

change_summary.notable_shift: The reading-role gains voice and cross-species acknowledgement. The feather's meaning stabilizes for the first time since Day 0 — it has been seen by crows, accepted by an elder, and tied to a public reading. Active burden korv_silence resolves through community attendance. Goals stay on read_what_others_leave; food is rising naturally now that the role is producing meals.
